Favorites and the server browser: favorites by public key (★ column, gold or an outline; Favorites tab with the favorites not on the list pinged at their last address, local ones found from favorites too when the list is down; Add a server row, pinned below the table once it scrolls), tabs Local / Favorites / Official / Community / All like Settings' (the last one remembered, Favorites by default, Local first only on the first look in a run), the server list's error above the tabs while the tabs show what they can, the list cached on disk (shown at once on the next start, a fresh one downloading in the background from the start, also with --connect), a favorite whose address another listed server has now is told so and not pinged. Connect - Custom server: Public key (recommended) - the key alone, found on the list, else a favorite's last address - or IP address with Expect public key (not verified without it), Add to favorites; scoreboard star for a favorite server; copy icons instead of Copy buttons; C opens Connect to server, P is Quick play; no menu hotkeys behind a modal. A key that is not the server's fails in about a second (yojimbo), a hand-typed key of another listed server is the player's choice, not the list's; a cut-off demo no longer ends the game. local-testing: no rm -rf in the Steam and web scenarios, community.sh SECS.
